cues.en: Instructor: You are looking at one of these slides from the previous video.
cues.zh: 講師：這是上一支影片的一張投影片。

cues.en: I hope you found this slide informative.
cues.zh: 希望你覺得資訊充足。

cues.en: I hope you found it enlightening about the dangers of overfitting, specifically with regards to generalization to new data sets.
cues.zh: 希望它讓你了解過度擬合的風險，尤其是泛化到新資料集的問題。

cues.en: So what you should do in this unsupervised learning challenge, is basically reproduce this figure and take it a step further as well.
cues.zh: 這個無監督學習挑戰，基本上要重現這張圖，再進一步探索。

cues.en: So there's two parts to this unsupervised learning challenge.
cues.zh: 挑戰有兩部分。

cues.en: Part one is just to generate the data to reproduce this figure.
cues.zh: 第一，產生資料，重現這張圖。

cues.en: So you need to create some data with some kind of a trend line in them and then add noise.
cues.zh: 建立帶有某種趨勢線的資料，再加雜訊。

cues.en: And then you fit a two-parameter model and a 10-parameter regression model.
cues.zh: 接著擬合兩參數與十參數的迴歸模型。

cues.en: So basically just reproduce this part.
cues.zh: 基本上重現這一部分。

cues.en: And then here you generate new data from the same underlying trend, but different noise.
cues.zh: 再從相同底層趨勢，產生雜訊不同的新資料。

cues.en: And then you fit these, you plot these data on top as well.
cues.zh: 接著擬合，並把這些資料也疊畫上去。

cues.en: So that's part one, is basically just getting the visualization down.
cues.zh: 第一部分，基本上是完成視覺化。

cues.en: Part two is to do some quantification.
cues.zh: 第二部分要量化。

cues.en: So what you want to do here is compute the R squared between the model prediction and the data.
cues.zh: 計算模型預測與資料之間的 R 平方。

cues.en: So the R squared for the model fit to the data for each of these four panels.
cues.zh: 也就是四個面板中，各模型對資料擬合的 R 平方。

cues.en: So the two and 10-parameter model to dataset one, and then the same models applied to dataset two.
cues.zh: 兩參數與十參數模型對資料集一，再把相同模型套到資料集二。

cues.en: So compute the R squared, and if you like, you could even take it a bit further.
cues.zh: 計算 R 平方，有興趣還可以更進一步。

cues.en: You could compute the F statistic if you want and see whether these models still fit the data significantly well and so on.
cues.zh: 可以計算 F 統計量，看看模型是否仍有顯著良好的擬合等等。

cues.en: But mainly what I want you to do is write code to get this visualization, to get a figure that looks something like this.
cues.zh: 但主要是寫程式完成這個視覺化，產生類似的圖。

cues.en: Obviously you don't need to worry about all the colors, just the general idea.
cues.zh: 不必在意各種顏色，只要整體概念。

cues.en: And then compute four R squared values for these four data model comparisons.
cues.zh: 再計算四個資料與模型比較的 R 平方值。
